facts.value: Refreshes the supplied fighter's already-selected dat_attrs storage with a typed ftFox_DatAttrs copy from that fighter's ft_data->ext_attr. It neither allocates storage nor redirects dat_attrs.
facts.rationale: Independently verified librarian correction: COPY_ATTRS differs from PUSH_ATTRS copy-and-install.

evidence.why: Exact destination and absence of pointer installation.

facts.value: Resolves Fighter from gobj, reads current dat_attrs as the ftFox_DatAttrs destination and ft_data->ext_attr as the source, then assigns the typed source value through that destination. Falco's LoadSpecialAttrs forwards its own gobj unchanged. Valid pre-existing destination storage is required.
facts.rationale: Replaces ambiguous activation language with canonical macro data flow.

facts.value: Forwards gobj and flag with fixed selectors 1,1. Shared handling skips heavy items; otherwise hold kinds 1,2,3,4 set pending part-animation slot 1 to selections 1,0,2,3 respectively, while other kinds leave it unchanged. A true flag requests application of the pending selection; pending -1 makes application a no-op. This adapter does not transfer item ownership.
facts.rationale: Preserves heavy guard, switch default, boolean paths, and sentinel behavior.

facts.value: Initializes 35 motion-state records annotated 341–375, grouped as six SpecialN, six SpecialS, seven SpecialHi, ten SpecialLw, and six AppealS bindings. Every initializer contains Anim, IASA, Phys, Coll, and camera callbacks. SpecialAirHi reuses ftFx_SM_SpecialHi; ground/air SpecialLwTurn reuse their respective Loop submotions; all six AppealS entries share the four AppealS phase callbacks. Detailed gameplay and R/L facing semantics are not established by these bindings alone.
facts.rationale: Provides a source-level inventory without adopting unsupported directional-taunt or compiled-layout interpretations.
